import json
s = json.loads(json_str)

# Build each line individually - no f-strings, no backticks, no pipes in problematic positions
L = []
L.append("# Cart Summary - Loyalty Points Redeemed")
L.append("")
L.append("## Customer Information")
L.append("- Name: " + s["customer"]["name"])
L.append("- Email: " + s["customer"]["email"])
L.append("- User ID: " + s["customer"]["user_id"])
L.append("- Loyalty Tier: " + s["customer"]["loyalty_tier"].upper())
L.append("")
L.append("## Cart Details")
L.append("- Cart ID: " + s["cart_id"])
L.append("")
L.append("### Items")
L.append("")

# Build table header and rows
hdr = " # , Product , Category , Qty , Unit Price , Line Total "
sep = "---,---------|----------|-----|-----------|------------"
L.append(hdr.replace(",", " | "))
L.append(sep.replace(",", " | "))

for i, item in enumerate(s["items"], 1):
    cells = [
        str(i),
        str(item["product_name"]),
        str(item["category"]),
        str(item["quantity"]),
        "$" + "{:.2f}".format(item["unit_price"]),
        "$" + "{:.2f}".format(item["line_total"]),
    ]
    row = " | ".join(cells)
    L.append(row)

L.append("")
L.append("### Pricing Breakdown")
L.append("")

price_hdr = " Description | Amount "
price_sep = "-------------|--------"
L.append(price_hdr)
L.append(price_sep)

price_rows = [
    ["Subtotal", "$" + "{:.2f}".format(s["subtotal"])],
    ["Loyalty Discount", "-$" + "{:.2f}".format(s["loyalty_discount"]["discount_amount"])],
    ["Shipping (" + s["shipping"]["option"] + ")", "$" + "{:.2f}".format(s["shipping"]["cost"])],
    ["Gift Wrap", "$" + "{:.2f}".format(s["gift_wrap_fee"])],
    ["NEW TOTAL", "$" + "{:.2f}".format(s["total_after_discount"])],
]
for pr in price_rows:
    L.append(pr[0] + " | " + pr[1])

L.append("")
L.append("### Loyalty Points Summary")
L.append("")

pts_hdr = " Detail | Value "
pts_sep = "--------|-------"
L.append(pts_hdr)
L.append(pts_sep)

pts_rows = [
    ["Points Before", "{:,}".format(s["loyalty_discount"]["points_available_before"])],
    ["Points Used", "{:,}".format(s["loyalty_discount"]["points_used"])],
    ["Points Remaining", "{:,}".format(s["loyalty_discount"]["points_remaining"])],
    ["Conversion Rate", s["loyalty_discount"]["conversion_rate"]],
]
for pt in pts_rows:
    L.append(pt[0] + " | " + pt[1])

L.append("")
L.append("---")
L.append("")
L.append("## Raw JSON Data")
L.append("")
L.append(json.dumps(s, indent=2))

md_content = "\n".join(L)
print("Markdown content built, length=" + str(len(md_content)))
